title: Ultimate Better Bells
description: Allows to tune bells like note blocks and interact with them from any direction!
body:

## ✨ Context
**This mod improves the Bell block entity in many ways. Here are all the features:**  
- The Bell is now an instrument you can tune exactly like the Note block.
- Left-click now rings the Bell once like a Note Block.
- Right-click changes the Bell's pitch on the same range as the Note Block.
- Redstone signals to a Bell will always play the same sound to keep it harmonious, allowing to use it like a real instrument!

**Other improvements:**
- Fixes vanilla's directional condition to ring the bell: now works regardless of direction.
- Allows the player to ring the bell by clicking any part of the block entity (as opposed to just the bell part).
- Fixes Farmer's Delight rope ringing the bell in the wrong direction: now correctly rings opposite to player.
****
## 🔓 Safe to use
By default, the tune of the bell is the same as vanilla (F#4). This mod does not change the Bell block behaviour at all, this means removing the mod will revert to vanilla and installing it carries zero risk :)
****
## ⚙️ No configuration required, ready to use!
****
## 🔗 Compatibility
- **This mod is highly compatible and should work with any mod that touches Bell Block and Bell Block Entity.**  
- **As stated above, it is compatible with Farmer's Delight Refabricated!**
